# ankra_application_demo_config (Resource)

What every pull-request demo of an application starts with: environment variables, a throwaway database, a shared base stack, a migration command, and an edge password guard. The counterpart of `ankra application demo config set`. The full-stack profile and component routing are not managed here and are left as they are. Destroying it restores the defaults: no variables, no database, no base stack and no password guard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_application_demo_config" "web" {
  application_id      = ankra_application.web.id
  database            = true
  database_extensions = ["pgcrypto"]
  migrate_command     = "npm run migrate"
  protected           = true

  env = [
    { name = "MODE", value = "demo" },
    { name = "STRIPE_KEY", value = "$${SECRET_SLOT:0f8f1c1e-9d0b-4c55-8a39-3c1e3b4f7a21}", secret = true },
  ]
}

output "demo_password" {
  value     = ankra_application_demo_config.web.generated_password
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Identifier of the application. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `base_stack_id` (String) Identifier of the shared demo base stack demos depend on.
- `database` (Boolean) Whether each demo gets its own Postgres database. Defaults to `false`.
- `database_extensions` (List of String) Postgres extensions the demo database creates. Needs `database`.
- `env` (Attributes List) Environment variables every demo starts with. A secret one carries `${SECRET_SLOT:<uuid>}` references rather than plaintext. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `migrate_command` (String) Command run in the application image before the demo starts. Needs `database` or `base_stack_id`.
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether demos sit behind Ankra's edge password guard. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `generated_password` (String, Sensitive) Password the platform minted when this resource turned protection on. It is only revealed once; it stays null when protection was already on, and `ankra application demo config rotate-password` replaces it. It is held in Terraform state in plain text (marked sensitive): protect the state, or leave `protected` to the CLI.
- `protected_username` (String) Login a protected demo accepts.

<a id="nestedatt--env"></a>
### Nested Schema for `env`

Required:

- `name` (String) Variable name.
- `value` (String) Variable value.

Optional:

- `secret` (Boolean) Whether the value references secret slots. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by application id.
terraform import ankra_application_demo_config.web 5b0c4a9e-2f43-4b8e-9a51-1f0d8e7c2a10
```
